verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Customer.io has a Pipelines/Track API that 'most of our integrations are based on' and note users can 'use your preferred tools and sources to transit data through Customer.io,' implying an integrations ecosystem exists, but no evidence names or documents maintained first-party connectors for Stripe, Shopify, Segment, or a product database specifically. missing for 10: explicit documentation of named Stripe/Shopify/Segment/CDP integrations, integration marketplace listing, maintenance/versioning details for these connectors.
